meta.name: Automated Deep-Bore Rig
meta.description: An autonomous clockwork automaton rig engineered by the Perpetual Clockwork Deep-Bore Syndicate. Powered by stormbreaker geodes, it stalls tool durability drain when interacting with stormbreaker geode beds and allows you to mine aggressively. A masterwork connecting raw copper and the Munchkin paradox grimoire into the mechanical synthesis.
meta.author: jules:steward
